run_detectron2_training: run detectron2 model training from a config file using the plain training loop entry point
run_detectron2_evaluation: run detectron2 model evaluation only on test datasets using the eval_only flag
review_do_train: review the do_train function that implements the plain training loop with optimizer and scheduler
review_do_test: review the do_test function that runs inference on datasets and prints CSV evaluation results
review_get_evaluator: review the get_evaluator function that creates dataset-specific evaluators like COCO and LVIS
